attributes.name: Two-stage to orbit rocket inertia model

header.description: Eric Queen's two-stage-to-orbit conceptual model. Inputs are amount of fuel burned from stage 1 and stage 2 and a staged flag. Outputs are mass properties and location of current moment reference center (in meters aft of the nose). Also the remaining fraction of fuel remaining in each stage (to judge depletion).
header.name: Two-stage to orbit rocket inertia model

attributes.name: Two-stage to orbit rocket inertia model

children.text: Eric Queen's two-stage-to-orbit conceptual model. Inputs are amount of fuel burned from stage 1 and stage 2 and a staged flag. Outputs are mass properties and location of current moment reference center (in meters aft of the nose). Also the remaining fraction of fuel remaining in each stage (to judge depletion).

references.description: Source document for data in this model

variables.description: Indicates if staging has occurred, if greater than zero.
variables.name: rocketHasStaged

variables.description: Indicates how much fuel has been expended from the first stage; used only if stagedFlag == 0. Used to linearly interpolate mass properties (CG, mass, moments of inertia) between full (0 fuel expended) and empty (all stage 1 fuel expended) reference values for each of these outputs.
variables.name: stage1fuelConsumed

variables.description: Indicates how much fuel has been expended from the second stage. Used to linearly interpolate mass properties (CG, mass, moments of inertia) between full (0 fuel expended) and empty (all stage 2 fuel expended) reference values for each of these outputs. Using a value other than 0 while stagedFlag == 0 will result in undefined results.
variables.name: stage2fuelConsumed

variables.description: Location of the moment reference center for the full (two-stage) vehicle, given in meters and measured from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft.
variables.name: fullVehicleMomentReferenceCenter

variables.description: Location of the moment reference center for the second-stage only vehicle, given in meters and measured from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft.
variables.name: secondStageMomentReferenceCenter

variables.description: Range of locations of center-of-mass of two-stage rocket prior to staging; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_XCG from Liftoff_XCG values given in REF01
variables.name: stage1XCGRange

variables.description: Range of values of the center-of-mass of the second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_XCG from S2Ignite_XCG values given in REF01
variables.name: stage2XCGRange

variables.description: Fuel capacity of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Mass from Liftoff_Mass values given in REF01
variables.name: stage1FuelCapacity

variables.description: Fuel capacity of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Mass from S2Ignite_Mass values given in REF01
variables.name: stage2FuelCapacity

variables.description: Range of values of Ixx of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Ixx from Liftoff_Ixx values given in REF01
variables.name: stage1IxxRange

variables.description: Range of values of Ixx of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Ixx from S2Ignite_Ixx values given in REF01
variables.name: stage2IxxRange

variables.description: Range of values of Iyy and Izz of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Iyy from Liftoff_Iyy values given in REF01
variables.name: stage1IyyRange

variables.description: Range of values of Iyy and Izz of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Iyy from S2Ignite_Iyy values given in REF01
variables.name: stage2IyyRange

variables.description: Position of the center of mass along the X-axis of the vehicle reference system (meters, positive aft). Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.
variables.name: vrsPositionOfCM_X

variables.description: Fraction of fuel remaining in stage 1, 0-1 (1 is full)
variables.name: stage1FuelRemainingFrac

variables.description: Fraction of fuel remaining in stage 2, 0-1 (1 is full)
variables.name: stage2FuelRemainingFrac

variables.description: Rolling moment of inertia about the body X axis. Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.
variables.name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Roll

variables.description: Pitching moment of inertia about the body Y axis Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.
variables.name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Pitch

variables.description: Yawing moment of inertia about the body Z axis. Identical to the pitching moment of inertia (XIYY).
variables.name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Yaw

variables.description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Z plane
variables.name: bodyProductOfInertia_ZX

variables.description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Y plane
variables.name: bodyProductOfInertia_XY

variables.description: Cross-product of inertia in the body Y-Z plane
variables.name: bodyProductOfInertia_YZ

variables.description: Total mass of vehicle Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.
variables.name: totalMass

variables.description: Longitudinal location of the moment reference center in meters back from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft. Value changes based on value of staged flag.
variables.name: vrsPositionOfMrc

variables.description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass relative to the nose of the vehicle; increasingly positive as the CM moves fwd as fuel is expended.
variables.name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_X

variables.description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass relative to the centerline of the vehicle; positive if the CM is to the right of the centerline
variables.name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Y

variables.description: Vertical location of the center of mass relative to the centerline of the vehicle; positive if the CM is below the centerline
variables.name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Z
